description: This file is an implementation of the GroupService interface, providing business logic for managing groups, including listing groups by type or IDs. It interacts with the GroupDao for data access and handles ServiceExceptions.

classes.name: GroupServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the GroupService interface, extending the generic service class and providing methods for listing groups by type or IDs.

methods.name: GroupServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor that injects the GroupDao dependency.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a list of groups filtered by GroupType, handling exceptions.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of groups based on a set of IDs, handling exceptions.
